Atmosphere.Darkness1: One flame remains. The Last Stand begins as darkness waits—vast, still and merciless.
Atmosphere.Darkness2: Only two flames endure. Darkness is total, heavy and silent, ready to swallow everything.
Atmosphere.Darkness3: Almost nothing remains to hold the dark back. Shadows press close, thick and impossible to ignore.
Atmosphere.Darkness4: Darkness fills everything. Each light trembles beneath its weight, and every breath feels threatening.
Atmosphere.Darkness5: Half the flames are gone. Darkness no longer surrounds the group; it seems to watch them.
Atmosphere.Darkness6: Light grows scarce. Shadows swallow every outline, leaving a dull, almost tangible dread.
Atmosphere.Darkness7: Darkness spreads. Each flame seems frailer, as though the night were learning how to smother it.
Atmosphere.Darkness8: The light retreats. Shadows thicken and draw close, their silence waiting for the slightest weakness.
Atmosphere.Darkness9: A flame dies. Darkness grows, still held back, yet close enough to weigh on every breath.
Atmosphere.Departure1: {name} reaches the end of the road. Their light fades gently, leaving the others strength to carry on.
Atmosphere.Departure10: {name} reaches the final line of their story. The curtain falls quietly, leaving a soft, enduring light.
Atmosphere.Departure2: {name} leaves the circle of flames. Their passage remains, a quiet mark darkness cannot erase.
Atmosphere.Departure3: For {name}, the journey ends here. Their story closes softly, but its traces remain with the others.
Atmosphere.Departure4: {name} gives way to silence. What they carried hangs in the air, ready to guide those who remain.
Atmosphere.Departure5: {name}'s road bends elsewhere. They leave the tale, but the echo of their choices stays with those behind.
Atmosphere.Departure6: {name} crosses a threshold the others cannot follow. Their light withdraws, but their memory remains.
Atmosphere.Departure7: {name}'s chapter ends. The page turns gently, while what they planted lives on in the story.
Atmosphere.Departure8: {name} leaves the circle for an unseen horizon. Behind them lingers a light darkness cannot reclaim.
Atmosphere.Departure9: The path parts for {name}. Their presence fades, but something of them stays with those moving on.
